after.name: gnomish_captive
after.lua_content:
-- name: gnomish_captive
-- Keep IdleQuest owner-scoped proximity/depop semantics; no static spawn is added.
-- Distinct from bloody_gnome_captive (118026), the existing Bloodmaw map recipient.
-- P99 bounded conversion review: 2026-10-22; see closure-review.json.
-- Original ProjectEQ flavor retained unless specifically documented; not a live-playability claim.
function event_spawn(e)
    local x, y = e.self:GetX(), e.self:GetY()
    eq.set_proximity(x - 20, x + 20, y - 20, y + 20)
end

function event_enter(e)
    e.self:Say("Please, somebody help me. This bear won't let me leave.")
    e.self:Emote("tries to hide from Bloodmaw deeper in the cave.")
    eq.clear_proximity()
    eq.depop()
end

-- name: Initiate_Sirchthain
-- timers: world
-- Runtime limitation: DoAnim is currently a no-op; original request retained.
-- Identity limitation: this original script key has no exact NPC name match; no alias or NPC row is invented.
-- P99 bounded conversion review: 2026-10-22; see closure-review.json.
-- Original ProjectEQ flavor retained unless specifically documented; not a live-playability claim.
local function reset_timer()
    -- Perl rand(40)+10 is [10,50) seconds, despite the inaccurate 10-40 comment.
    eq.set_timer("2", math.floor((math.random() * 40 + 10) * 1000))
end

function event_spawn(e)
    reset_timer()
end

function event_timer(e)
    e.self:DoAnim(2)
    reset_timer()
end

after.lua_content:
-- name: Lieutenant_Ulfur
-- actors: world
-- Engine adaptation: event_spawn starts existing grid30 (spawn25629), preserving all24 points and pauses.
-- Player-scene bootstrap and live navigation are not independently validated here.
-- P99 bounded conversion review: 2026-10-22; see closure-review.json.
-- Original ProjectEQ flavor retained unless specifically documented; not a live-playability claim.
function event_spawn(e)
    -- Promote the existing exact native circular patrol to durable callback delivery.
    -- Runtime admission rejects another active route for this actor lifetime.
    eq.start(30)
end

function event_say(e)
    if e.message:findi("hail") then
        e.self:Say("Hail, there, " .. e.other:GetRaceName() .. ". How goes it? Much fairer than I, I'll wager. Me troops can't hit the broad side of a mammoth with their crossbows. Oh, by the way, I'm Lieutenant Ulfur, Commander of the 23rd Coldain crossbow regiment, if ye kin call it a regiment.")
    end
    if e.message:findi("regiment") then
        e.self:Say("Yes. we assist our troops in military endeavors. Although we're almost more harm than good. All me troops have soldier envy. They want in the middle of the rumble, face ta face with their enemies stompin them into the ground. That's all well and good but a contingent of crossbowmen can be the difference in winning or losing. Do you favor ranged weapons, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. "?")
    end
    if e.message:findi("yes") then
        e.self:Say("Ahh, well, maybe sometime I'll let ya try out one of our famed crossbows. Maybe even give ye one if ye prove yerself to the Coldain cause. Unfortunately. though. we can spare no crossbows now. Perhaps in the future we will be able to.")
    end
    if e.message:findi("no") then
        e.self:Say("Heh, figures. Almost no one kin fully appreciate the warm feelin' ye get when a bolt ye fired splits the skull of yer adversary. They don't even see it comin'; kinda absolvers yer guilt fer killin' another bein'. Anonymous killin', heheheh.")
    end
end

    if e.wp == 15 then
